## Task
Survey ISO/IEC 18013-5 mDL selective disclosure, W3C Verifiable Credentials 2.0 and OpenID4VP: which states issue mobile IDs, and what a relying party needs. Draft a privacy-request endpoint format (security.txt-style discovery plus a JSON request accepting a selective-disclosure proof). List the regulators and organisations to approach.

## Acceptance
A memo plus a draft spec; no code.
